text:
ashley: quick sync 'til noon. we hit a weird window where proxies with local caches admitted more than central ledger showed. want to lock down safety heuristics before we spec refill API.

dmitri: reproduced in staging. root cause: multiple proxies independently using small caches + async central reconciliation.

kevin: thinking of naming: 'reservoirs' or 'local pockets'. either way we need strong bookkeeping to avoid double-grants. refill should be idempotent and include a sequence number.

maria: safety heuristics we should include: 1) per-proxy per-tenant ledger persisted at central on each refill grant 2) emergency throttle when observed_local_spend - central_spend > threshold for window 3) per-tenant policy (enterprise vs free) controlling emergency buffer size.

lee: admission flow sketch: proxy checks reservoir -> if enough, consume locally and emit spend event; if insufficient, call central refill (sync with 30-40ms budget). central may grant 0 (fast-decline) to force sync-only. if central times out, proxy consults emergency buffer rules then either admit or 429.

ashley: add security: refill only over mTLS, require proxy_id + idempotency token, and server-side per-proxy rate-limits to prevent refill amplification./ Also persist grants so ledger reconciliation can run post-hoc.

kevin: example API:

POST /quota/v2/reservoirs/refill
{
  "tenant_id":"t-900",
  "proxy_id":"px-eu-3",
  "req":20,
  "seq": 101,
  "idempotency_key":"abc"
}

=> {"granted":6,"lease_ms":400}

Proxies write local spend logs and ship batched ack events to central for reconciliation.

maria: telemetry: reservoir_granted_total, reservoir_spent_total, reservoir_reconcile_delta, reservoir_fast_declines. Alert if reconcile_delta > 5% for 1s or >2% for 10s.

dmitri: rollout plan: 1) shadow mode (proxies record decisions, no local admits) 2) enable tiny reservoirs for canary tenants only (5-10 tokens) 3) strict alarms + auto-freeze if delta spikes 4) widen by tier. include rollback: feature flag to force central-only.

lee: ops note: ensure canary has full reconciliation job enabled and retention for per-proxy ledger.

ashley: owners & ETA: kevin -> RFC + proto (5d); maria -> telemetry + dashboards (4d); dmitri -> security checklist + rate-limits (3d); lee -> rollout runbook & infra checks (3d).

tara-bot: reminder: canary window scheduled 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC.

ashley: thanks. i'll draft RFC summary and link kevin's proto. objections? :thumbsup:
